package course

import (
	"context"
	"time"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain/repository"
)

// UpdateCourseInput holds input values.
type UpdateCourseInput struct {
	CourseID            string
	Slug                string
	MainTechID          *int
	Status              *int
	CatalogVisible      *bool
	LessonReadAccess    *domain.LessonReadAccess
	LessonReadAccessSet bool
}

// UpdateCourse updates course fields.
type UpdateCourse struct {
	Courses   repository.CourseRepository
	Lessons   repository.LessonRepository
	Publisher domain.EventPublisher
	Tx        repository.TransactionManager
}

// Handle performs update and emits event.
func (uc UpdateCourse) Handle(ctx context.Context, in UpdateCourseInput) (*domain.Course, error) {
	var course *domain.Course

	run := func(fn func(ctx context.Context) error) error {
		if uc.Tx != nil {
			return uc.Tx.WithTx(ctx, fn)
		}
		return fn(ctx)
	}

	if err := run(func(ctx context.Context) error {
		var err error
		course, err = uc.Courses.GetByID(ctx, in.CourseID)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}

		if in.Slug != "" {
			course.Slug = in.Slug
		}
		if in.MainTechID != nil {
			course.MainTechID = in.MainTechID
		}
		if in.Status != nil {
			if *in.Status != course.Status {
				if *in.Status == domain.CourseStatusActive {
					hasActiveLesson, err := uc.hasActiveLesson(ctx, course.ID)
					if err != nil {
						return err
					}
					if !hasActiveLesson {
						return domain.ErrInvalidStatus
					}
				}
				if *in.Status == domain.CourseStatusNoActive && course.Status != domain.CourseStatusActive {
					return domain.ErrInvalidStatus
				}
			}
			course.Status = *in.Status
		}
		if in.CatalogVisible != nil {
			course.CatalogVisible = *in.CatalogVisible
		}
		if in.LessonReadAccessSet {
			if err := domain.ValidateLessonReadAccess(in.LessonReadAccess); err != nil {
				return err
			}
			course.LessonReadAccess = in.LessonReadAccess
		}
		course.UpdatedAt = time.Now().UTC()

		if err := uc.Courses.Update(ctx, *course); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		return nil
	}); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	_ = uc.Publisher.Publish(ctx, domain.SubjectCourseUpdated, map[string]any{
		"course_id": course.ID,
		"slug":      course.Slug,
	})

	return course, nil
}

func (uc UpdateCourse) hasActiveLesson(ctx context.Context, courseID string) (bool, error) {
	if uc.Lessons == nil {
		return false, domain.ErrValidation
	}

	lessons, err := uc.Lessons.ListByCourse(ctx, courseID)
	if err != nil {
		return false, err
	}
	for _, lesson := range lessons {
		if lesson.Status == domain.LessonStatusActive {
			return true, nil
		}
	}

	return false, nil
}
